description: Defines the sdap_entity_impl class implementing SDAP entity handling, including mapping, handling SDUs, and managing RX/TX mappings within the ocudu namespace.

classes.name: sdap_entity_impl
classes.description: Implements SDAP entity with mapping, handling SDUs, and managing RX/TX mappings.

methods.name: get_sdap_rx_pdu_handler
methods.description: Retrieves the RX PDU handler for a given DRB ID.

methods.name: handle_sdu
methods.description: Handles incoming SDU and redirects to the mapped DRB.

methods.name: is_mapped
methods.description: Checks if a QFI is mapped.

methods.name: add_mapping
methods.description: Adds a new mapping between QFI and DRB ID with configuration.

methods.name: remove_mapping
methods.description: Removes mapping for a given DRB ID.
